Rates.title: Breaking: UK CPI inflation arrives at 3.0% YoY in February, as expected
Rates.summary: The United Kingdom (UK) headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 3.0% over the year in February, compared to a rise of 3.0% in January, the data released by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Wednesday.

Rates.title: AUD: Inflation shock keeps RBA under pressure – Commerzbank
Rates.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur notes Australian CPI slowed on a monthly basis but remains above the Reserve Bank of Australia’s (RBA) 2–3% target.

Rates.title: RBNZ’s Conway sees economic slack shaping response to oil shock
Rates.summary: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Chief Economist Paul Conway said that the central bank sees lingering slack in the economy that will shape how aggressively it responds to the inflationary aftershocks of higher oil prices, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar struggles as Oil prices continue to ease
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends gains for the second successive day, trading around 1.3770 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair gains ground as crude oil prices soften on the easing geopolitical tone, weighing on the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD).

FX.title: EUR/CHF: SNB threat seen as limited deterrent – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen highlights that the Swiss Franc (CHF) has weakened since the Iran war began, helped by ultra-low Swiss inflation and the Swiss National Bank’s (SNB) persistent intervention threats.

FX.title: EUR/USD: Repricing supports cautious upside – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank’s Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley notes that the Euro has recently become the best performing G10 currency as markets reprice European Central Bank (ECB) tightening.

Commodities.title: Brent: Negotiation risks keep energy outlook fragile – MUFG
Commodities.summary: MUFG’s Senior Currency Analyst Michael Wan notes that Brent Oil has dropped to around US$100 as the Dollar weakened on signs of US–Iran talks, but he stresses that negotiations are likely to be very difficult.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Flat lines below $88.00; 200-hour SMA breakdown remains in play
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) Crude Oil prices reverse an intraday fall to the $86.00 mark, back closer to the overnight swing low, though traders seem reluctant to place directional bets amid mixed geopolitical signals.

Commodities.title: Gold jumps over 2% as oil slump eases inflation fears amid Trump Iran talks
Commodities.summary: Gold climbed as declining oil prices helped temper worries over persistent inflation following reports that Washington is working on a proposal to bring an end to the Middle East conflict.
